as_told.title: Friend in charge of technology transfer from a group of ETs

plain: A friend of Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant, is said to have handled a "technology transfer", a handover of know-how, with one group of aliens who had developed magnetic propulsion, a way of moving craft by magnetism. Buchanan tells Michels this as something the friend told him, and in another mention says simply that the friend was in charge of technology transfer from the ETs, without the magnetic part. If true, it would mean people had dealings with aliens that included learning how their craft fly.
